subject: english
question:
**Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A. dictators may rise to power and inaugurate

B. a new regime with dramatic suddenness

C. and success under suitable conditions

D. democracy is always a slow growth
solution:
The correct answer is: **DABC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence talks about the rise of dictators and the inauguration of a new regime.
 
• **Part D** sets the context by stating that democracy takes time to develop.
 
• **Part A** introduces the main idea of the sentence.
 
• **Part B** adds more detail about how the regime came into power.
 
• **Part C** provides a condition for the success of the regime.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
